displayName: NBD Pro — Tenant microsite config errors (getPublicSiteConfig 500s)

documentation.content:
getPublicSiteConfig (functions/handlers/public-site.js) is throwing — every tenant microsite at /sites/t/<slug> renders from this endpoint, and since the 2026-07-04 Oaks cutover that includes oaksroofingandconstruction's live site. A sustained failure = tenant sites are DOWN (the template shows its error state).

Expected non-errors that do NOT trip this policy: 404 not_found (bad slug), 400 bad_key, 429 rate-limit — those return without logger.error. Only the catch-all 500 path logs 'getPublicSiteConfig failed'.

Common causes:
  1. Firestore outage / permission regression on companies//companyProfile reads.
  2. A deploy that broke the handler (roll back via ROLLBACK.md).
  3. Malformed companyProfile doc for one tenant (check the err message for the doc id).

Investigate:
  gcloud functions logs read getPublicSiteConfig --project nobigdeal-pro --gen2 --limit 100
  # then curl https://nobigdealwithjoedeal.com/api/site-config?key=oaks — a 200 with JSON means recovered.
